name: Jangwoo Park
about: I am an undergraduate student in Interior Architecture Design at Hanyang University, with a second major in Computer Science.

My interests lie in human–computer interaction and AI systems that support designers. I explore how AI can help people express their intentions and draw on their past decisions, while keeping them in control of the final judgment.

experience.description: Designed LLM prompts for conversational image search and studied vague degree expressions in user requests.
Built a floorplan-to-DWG pipeline and a Unity platform for a Bayesian Information Gain study; conducted the user study and explored sketch-style learning. Formerly Design Informatics Lab.

honors: Encouragement Award · Self-Driving Car Youth Challenge, Fall 2020

skills.Research & prototyping: PyTorch, OpenCV, Unity, Arduino, Raspberry Pi
skills.Design: Rhino, SketchUp, Blender, AutoCAD, Revit, Photoshop, Illustrator
